selected_object.label: Soggy Kitchen Sponge
selected_object.description: Yellow cellulose sponge soaked in soapy suds and sheer determination.

announcer_lines.intro: SOGGY KITCHEN SPONGE DETECTED! Prepare for extreme, squeaky, suds-powered destruction.

round1.intro: SCRUB THE HAUNTED HOUSE: Pull back the giant wet sponge and wash away the paranormal infestation!
round1.win: SQUEAKY CLEAN EVICTION: Ghosts wiped out without a single water spot left on the floorboards!
round1.lose: NEEDS MORE DETERGENT: The cobwebs absorbed the impact. Grab the steel wool!

round2.intro: ALIEN DISHWASHING EMERGENCY: The mothership galley ran out of sponges! Tap to beam it up!
round2.win: DISHES SAVED: Extraterrestrial crew celebrated the arrival of industrial-grade cellulose!
round2.lose: DROPPED IN THE DISHWATER: The tractor beam slipped on the soapy bubbles!

round3.intro: VOLCANO SIZZLE: The lava is boiling hot! Keep the damp sponge from drying out!
round3.win: STILL DAMP: You dodged every flaming cinder and kept your soapy bubbles intact!
round3.lose: DRIED TO A CRISP: The magma toasted the sponge into a crusty crouton!

announcer_lines.summary: CLEANUP COMPLETE: The kitchen sponge scrubbed haunted houses, saved alien galleys and survived volcanic sizzle.
